'''Fillarik Arms and Demolitions''' was an arms and explosives business that was situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was a covert front for the activities of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. [[Lekern Renald]] worked for the company as part of his cover. The company's building was later converted into the [[Sobrik Vehicle Depot]].
